Hi all — quick technical questions to prep for the kickoff: 

1) SCIM provisioning: do you plan to use push-based provisioning from Okta -> Redwood SCIM endpoint, or will you run periodic CSV syncs initially? If push-based, we'll need the base URL and a test user for provisioning.

2) Service accounts: we recommend two names (redwood-sync-staging, redwood-sync-prod). Do you have an internal key rotation policy (e.g., 90 days)? We support both long-lived API keys (with IP restriction) and short-lived JWTs via rotation job.

3) IP allowlists: for prod we'll need the public egress IPs for your firewall team to allow to your SSO callback endpoint; for staging we'll add a temporary entry and tighten later.

I'll draft a short-runbook for the call covering endpoints, headers, and sample SCIM payloads and attach it after our internal review.

Best,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
